responsibility: This file implements the default executable behavior for many entries of the lang_hooks interface that connects a frontend to GCC’s language-independent core. It supplies fallback routines for option postprocessing, declaration naming and assembler-name mangling, builtin function and type registration, alias-set and type compatibility queries, diagnostics helpers, LTO section begin/append/end output, DWARF attribute hooks, early debug finalization, and miscellaneous no-op or pass-through callbacks, so front ends override only the language-specific pieces they need.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the default runnable implementations behind the lang_hooks interface defined in gcc/langhooks.h, including fallback frontend callbacks and helpers, rather than defining the lang_hooks structures and declarations themselves.
